letter.subtitle: Ordinary days have become special
letter.body:
Thank you babi, for always being by my side, on the sunny days that shine so bright, and on the nights we cried huhu. 
With you, even the small things become memories worth keeping. A late dinner, a hug for no reason, or just a message. 
I'm not good at saying pretty words, so I just want to say: I love you more than I ever let on. 
Here's to many more chapters together.
